description: If \(m\le n\), restricting a surviving length-\(n\) binary assignment to its first \(m\) coordinates gives a surviving length-\(m\) assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.prefix_survives_restrict
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (r : Fin n → Bool)
  (hr : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.PrefixSurvives Γ n r) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.PrefixSurvives Γ m fun i => r (Fin.castLE hmn i)
